pain_points: Golf shop is short-staffed in summer - about 40 to 50 rounds a day on a skeleton crew, so the shop is understaffed and Greg jumps in on the counter

Setting up a new customer profile over the phone bogs the golf shop down: the caller has to be walked through name, contact details, credit card and rules acknowledgement before a first tee time can be booked

Enforcement of the $75 no-show fee depends on the customer having a profile with a card on file and having acknowledged the rules, so any booking channel that skips profile creation weakens the policy
Repetitive inbound questions and bookings occupy shop staff who are serving players in person
April revenue missed budget because the local music festivals absorb area hotel rooms, which pushed the course to GolfNow trade times for May and June
current_solution: Club Profit on both courses, with a POS/tee-sheet switch to Lightspeed or Club Caddy planned (vendor chosen by mid-July, transition first week of August). GolfNow supplies one trade time per day on the South Course; Notifi sends confirmation and cancellation reminders that support the $75 no-show policy; inbound calls land on a staffed phone tree with options for booking, golf shop, restaurant, GM and sales/marketing; new customers create a profile with a credit card on the website.

Tee-time search and booking for two players with price quoted per player and in total
Name capture with spelling confirmation and read-back before locking the booking
Weather forecast answer for the day of play
Dashboard view the course would get access to
Notice board where the course posts items such as cart path only, which the concierge weaves into calls

He committed to getting a definitive answer from his team and to recording a Loom video of the profile-creation workflow, and accepted Greg's offer to walk the course's own website signup flow to see what the buildout has to match.

He then asked whether he should proactively send an agreement, framed explicitly as not for signature but for Greg and the team to review, so the paperwork cycle could start in parallel with the outstanding profile question.
